svg.title: Where the math lives
svg.desc: Six figures from my code: 1) an XPBD distance constraint, as in Carrona's physics; 2) analytic two-bone inverse kinematics; 3) zooming about the cursor as a homothety, as in Lux and Lumen; 4) the eight EXIF orientations as the dihedral group D4, as in Prisma; 5) a QR code made by clip2qr's own Reed-Solomon encoder over GF(2^8), linking to github.com/agustinyarrus/clip2qr; 6) a Dijkstra flow field that steers every zombie in Carrona. All six are animated from the real algorithms: the constraint rings down over 14 substeps, the leg walks, the image zooms about the cursor, an F walks through the group, the QR code is damaged and still scans, and the horde follows the field as the target moves. With reduced motion they are still.
